title: Doesn’t  glow like the shows
text: Doesn’t  glow like the shows. I bought four of these for the kids and myself. Not impressed at all. My son likes it cause he has a black light to charge it.. But I’m not going to buy a black light to go around charging clocks every night….

product_metadata.title: Brmeday Modern Night Light Wall Clock, 12 Inch Silent Non-Ticking Quartz Wall Clocks, Large Luminous Numbers and Hands, Battery Powered Clock Decor for Living Room Bedroom Kitchen Office
features: 【Glow in the Dark Wall Clock】The night light wall clock hands and numbers on the dial will automatically glow at night. The more sunlight or fluorescent light it can absorb during the day, the better it will glow at night. As the energy is released, the brightness of the light will gradually decrease.

【Non-ticking & Silent Running】Our lighted wall clock has premium quality of the precise quartz movement guarantee accurate time and keep a silent environment when the second hand is moving. Say goodbye to the annoying ticking.

【Easy To Read & Clear Glass】The large arab numbers on the 12 inch dial are clear and easy to read for you from any corner, perfect for bedroom, living room, office decoration. The high-definition glass cover is not only more beautiful for this clock but also has a dust-proof effect.

【Modern and Simple Design】Our night light wall clock is round in shape and made of ABS with HD ultra-thin glass cover, simulate wooden grain texture with a simple and vintage appearance, Great gift choice for your family, friend, classmates in festivals or important time.
【Simple to Use】Powered by one AA battery (not included). Please avoid using rechargeable batteries, which will shorten the life of the wall clock movement and affect the accuracy of the time.
